repair_rules.block:
<!-- unattended-distillation:route-lock -->
## Automatic distillation route lock

For reference reconstruction and editable PPTX work, `ai-ppt-editable` is the only default execution engine. `GordenImage2PPTX` is a region-only fallback and may never replace formal text, semantic panels, cards, tables, charts, or a whole slide. A route or backend mismatch is a blocker, not a reason to silently substitute an engine.
<!-- /unattended-distillation:route-lock -->

<!-- unattended-distillation:native-structure-lock -->
## Automatic distillation native-structure lock

Simple frames, cards, panels, dividers and arrows must be native PowerPoint shapes or groups. Verified tables must be native PowerPoint tables with row, column, merge and data-snapshot evidence. Formal text must remain native text or table-cell rich text. A semantic frame image or flattened table is a hard failure.
<!-- /unattended-distillation:native-structure-lock -->

<!-- unattended-distillation:text-visual-lock -->
## Automatic distillation text and visual lock

Run both rendered comparison and native text/run-style inspection. Missing glyphs, flattened formal copy, stale font evidence, lost icons, and untracked gradients are blockers; a technically present object is not enough.
<!-- /unattended-distillation:text-visual-lock -->

<!-- unattended-distillation:package-lock -->
## Automatic distillation package lock

Every automatic repair must be limited to the policy allowlist, preserve the three-skill package boundary, pass package and route validators, and leave an auditable report. Executable code, workflow files, dependencies and assets are protected from unattended edits.
<!-- /unattended-distillation:package-lock -->
